title: The guard refuses a `git checkout <path>` or `git restore <path>` over an uncommitted change
why: About 04:30 CST Nov 8, a builder's `git checkout hooks/guard_frozen.py` in its own worktree was not refused. It would have dropped an uncommitted change. Nothing was lost, because a backup existed (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 04:41 CST).
note: Fix: the guard refuses the path form of checkout and restore when the path has an uncommitted change. Red rows first, from a test-author who also finds the cause. Branch guard-checkout-path-restore from main, as a follow-up PR with `Merge after:` naming the other-checkout-read PR. Related, not a duplicate: step builder-checkout-test-path (#1732) covers a test path restored from an old sha. The coordinator folded it into lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (04:38 CST Nov 8). Queue fix (owner item 386). Filed 04:40 CST Nov 8. Sighting (lane handoff-sections-kept, #2320, via the coordinator 17:20 CST Nov 8): a builder discarded its own edit with `git checkout -- <path>`.
